title: Party Wall — a photos wall for events
description: The first demo consumer of the full LLP 0044 asset pipeline: strip-declared photo uploads with required variants publish through trusted finalization, attach to wall posts via the canonical ctx.assets.attach handler, share exactly along event membership (join grants, leave revokes) through via-references, deliver strictly with ranges, plus public-immutable covers, signed-bearer share links, referenced-delete refusal → cascade, reference GC, and seed photo fixtures through the trusted path.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headless: seed fixtures ingest through the trusted finalization path on a dev sibling and resolve $assetFixture placeholders into rows
a host uploads a GPS-strippable photo to ready with the required thumb variant and a server ThumbHash
the canonical handler ctx.assets.attach lands the post on the membership-gated live wall
joining an event grants via-references reads and strict delivery; leaving revokes; never-members see nothing
the event cover publishes public-immutable and serves without a session (protocol header caveat recorded)
signed URLs issue for the private-signed intent as bounded bearers; strict photos refuse issuance
explicit delete refuses while a post references the photo; deleting the post clears the edge and the cascade completes
react: the browser arm builds over the real workspace packages and generated api (full walkthrough is manual per README; browser sessions sign-in is a recorded gap)

capabilityGaps: live queries cannot return tables containing v.assetRef fields (result-contract gap) — the wall uses the split posts/photoShares workaround
dev-mode asset HTTP resolves anonymous, so per-user asset flows require sessions custody; the browser sign-in flow uses the dev mailbox with an admin token (trusted-local only)
sessions-mode servers require the auth-client protocol header on every request, including public-immutable and signed URLs — public links are not yet plain-pasteable
no operator verb drives the reference-GC sweep deterministically; the suite proves the edge-cleared state via explicit delete instead
notClaiming: video walls (photo intents only; video finalization exists but is not exercised here)
share links for existing strict photos (delivery policy follows the asset; sharing uses a separate private-signed intent)
